disabledList.message: NSX licenses must have all of [DFW]
NSX licenses must have all of [EDGEFW_SECURITY]
NSX licenses must have all of [VPC_SECURITY]
NSX licenses must have all of [VPC_SECURITY]

strategies.name: none
strategies.description: 'None' security strategy implies the attached VPC would not have any security strategy attached to it. This strategy will be marked as the 'Default' security strategy by the system by default

strategies.name: vpc-external-connectivity
strategies.description: Allow only Outgoing Communications, deny all incoming connections. VPC to VPC communication is blocked

strategies.name: vpc-isolation
strategies.description: Deny any communication between VPCs within the project. All workloads within the VPC to be allowed to communicate

strategies.name: vpc-isolation-with-essential-services
strategies.description: Deny all communication to VPCs except for essential services like ICMP, DNS, NTP and DHCP. All workloads within the VPC to be allowed to communicate

strategies.name: vpc-secure-connection
strategies.description: Allow all outgoing communications, deny incoming connections. Allow VPC to VPC within project
